html:
Remark. Quantum-modularity of the bar-involution (conjectural analogy)

Remark (quantum-modularity of the bar-involution). Conjecturally, the bar-involution q\mapsto q^{-1} serves as the fibre-level avatar of the quantum-modular S-transform q\mapsto\tilde q. The Kashaev asymptotics near roots of unity are quantum modular. Under this reading, the bar-odd requirement on a_1 represents the odd part under the S-transform, and the \sqrt{u} prefactor represents the radial asymptotic. This remains a motivated analogy, not a theorem.
